crossRefs.note: You shall bring out of your habitations two loaves of bread for a wave offering made of two tenths of an ephah of fine…
offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving of that which is leavened, and proclaim free will offerings and brag about them: for…
He spoke another parable to them. “The Kingdom of Heaven is like yeast, which a woman took, and hid in three measures…
For every creature of God is good, and nothing is to be rejected, if it is received with thanksgiving.

translations.web: He shall offer his offering with the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving with cakes of leavened bread.
translations.bsb: Along with his peace offering of thanksgiving he is to present an offering with cakes of leavened bread.
translations.kjv: Besides the cakes, he shall offer for his offering leavened bread with the sacrifice of thanksgiving of his peace offerings.
translations.asv: With cakes of leavened bread he shall offer his oblation with the sacrifice of his peace-offerings for thanksgiving.
